verdict.rationale: The evidence does not show Cactus itself accepting natural-language commands to run its platform tasks, such as generating data, fine-tuning, managing billing or downloading models. The documented route is driving the API through an external coding agent with an API key, which is a user-side workaround. Needle's natural-language-to-tool-call capability is a model that developers embed in their own apps, so it is a building block rather than a way to operate Cactus.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands
